_comment: root_sink live histograms for the ThGEM experiment (pf-qaq), after side3's
xy1/xy2 delay-line images (+-250 ns, the ThGEM physical extent), tof1/tof2 = the
[70,190] ns zoom of dt1/dt2 (LiveEventBuilder.C hTOF; the -70 ns display offset is
not applied). Reload without restarting: curl http://localhost:8090/ReloadHists/cmd.json
NOTE: the coinc/pos matchers select hits by CHANNEL ONLY (module ignored). With more
than one digitizer, other boards' channels 0-10 leak into them - see the TOML header.
